mapper.select: SELECT n.no,n.subject,TO_CHAR(n.regdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') as dbday, m.name as instuctor, filename FROM course_notice n JOIN course c ON c.no=n.course_id JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id WHERE course_id=#{course_id} ORDER BY no DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_notice WHERE course_id=#{course_id}
